node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N02、N09、N10、N11-N14、N17 提供同一结构上下文引用。
must_not_emit: 真实结构坐标或预测结果
真实置信分数或质量结论

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N06、N09、N10、N13、N17 提供 WT 拓扑与 RSA 占位事实。

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N06 提供本地文献表位证据占位集合。
must_disclose: zero-hit is an explicit stub fact
must_not_emit: 真实文献命中、区间或接触残基
公网 IEDB/BLAST 查询结果

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N06 提供 WT B 细胞线性表位占位事实。
must_not_emit: 真实表位区间、概率或阈值结果

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N06 提供 WT T 细胞呈递占位事实。
must_not_emit: 真实肽段、等位基因评分或覆盖率

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N07、N11、N13、N17 提供三图占位引用。
must_not_emit: 真实密度、热点坐标或 E0-E4 科学分级

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N11、N13 和 N18 提供 WT 糖基化占位事实。

must_not_emit: 真实同源序列、MSA 或保守分数

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N11-N15、N17 提供功能域与 core map 占位引用。
must_not_emit: 真实域坐标、二硫键或 core 判定

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 Gate、N11、N13、N15、N18 提供 WT 基线占位事实。

must_not_emit: 真实可开发性数值或综合分数

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N12 提供本轮合成候选引用及权限追溯占位事实。

真实突变建议或工具分数
验证、排名或重算控制结果

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N14/N15 提供候选级复评占位事实，且不覆盖 WT 基线。

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N15 提供相对原始 WT 的候选稳定性占位事实。

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 为 N16/N18 提供 shortlist 或 WT 降级建议占位事实。
must_not_emit: 真实 Hard Filter/Pareto/权重分数或名次

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 仅在场景明确 EXECUTE 且节点成功时为 N18 提供 DNA 占位引用。

从 host_species 推断表达宿主

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 在适用时为 N18 提供 WT 稳定性参考扫描占位事实。
must_not_emit: 真实 ΔΔG、突变或双引擎排序
N14 候选 BuildModel 分数
S-32/MD 结果或适用性控制结果

node_output_responsibilities.downstream_responsibility: 组装已有 Mock 引用、逐支状态和风险披露；形成未部署交接事实。
must_not_emit: 虚假 delivered 或 Agent C 接通声明

scenarios.display_name: 主链成功：甲方提供本地结构
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖提供结构、完整设计路径与双分支成功。
scenario_specific_assertions: N01 emits provided-local structure source stub
N16 and N17 settle before E026

scenarios.display_name: 主链成功：无结构走本地 AF3 占位路由
scenarios.purpose: 证明无结构时只选择场景指定的本地 AF3 路由。
scenario_specific_assertions: No S-07/RCSB/AlphaFold DB edge or fact exists
N01 route is literal, not selected by model execution

scenarios.display_name: 主链成功：无结构走本地 ESMFold2 占位路由
scenarios.purpose: 证明无结构时可由场景显式选择本地 ESMFold2 路由。
scenario_specific_assertions: No remote fallback is permitted
No runtime quality comparison selects the route

scenarios.display_name: Gate 不适合设计：WT 直达
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖 E012/E013、N11-N17 分支跳过和 WT 正常交付。
scenario_specific_assertions: N11-N17 are SKIPPED_BRANCH, never SUCCEEDED
Gate result is a literal, not derived from N10

scenarios.display_name: N12 第二轮通过
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖一次 E016 回边并保留两轮 N11/N12 attempt。
scenario_specific_assertions: N12 decisions are RECALC_REQUIRED then VALIDATED_CANDIDATES_AVAILABLE
N11 budgets are 24 then 48

scenarios.display_name: N12 第三轮通过
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖两次 E016 回边并在第三轮通过。
scenario_specific_assertions: N12 decisions contain two RECALC_REQUIRED literals then one validation literal
N11 budgets are 24, 48, 64

scenarios.display_name: N12 三轮耗尽失败
scenario_specific_assertions: No fourth design cycle exists
Scientific rejection reasons are not fabricated

scenarios.display_name: N15 建议 WT 降级
scenarios.purpose: 区别于 Gate WT：设计路径已执行，N16 无候选未执行，N17 仍结算后汇合。
scenario_specific_assertions: E021-E026 remain present
N16 NOT_EXECUTED is not SKIPPED_BRANCH

scenarios.display_name: N16 缺少表达宿主：条件跳过
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖显式 null 输入、N16 条件跳过和 N17 成功汇合。
scenario_specific_assertions: host_species is never used as expression_host
N16 emits no successful output

scenarios.display_name: N17 不适用：条件跳过
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖受保护 N17 保留身份但按场景事实条件跳过。
scenario_specific_assertions: No membrane or confidence calculation is performed
N17 remains in node_plan and E023/E025

scenarios.display_name: N16 明确但不支持的表达宿主
scenarios.purpose: 用保留 sentinel 覆盖 N16 失败，而不是把明确值改写为缺失。
scenario_specific_assertions: Unsupported is a synthetic sentinel, not a claim about a real host
N18 preserves the N16 error

scenarios.display_name: N17 分支失败后汇合
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖 N16 成功、N17 失败、N18 保留缺口并完成组装。
scenario_specific_assertions: N17 failure is not rewritten to success
E025/E026 remain observable

scenarios.display_name: N16 分支超时并保留部分结果
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖 TIMED_OUT、PARTIAL_STUB 与宽容汇合。
scenario_specific_assertions: Partial stub contains no DNA or scientific values
N18 preserves timeout and partial artifact refs

scenarios.display_name: N08 上游工具失败
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖 N01-N15 硬阻断、下游未执行和运行失败。
scenario_specific_assertions: No success edge E009 exists
No control decision is inferred after the upstream terminal

scenarios.display_name: N01 本地预测失败且禁止联网回退
scenarios.purpose: 证明本地占位失败后直接失败，不恢复 S-07/RCSB/AFDB。
scenario_specific_assertions: No E002 traversal exists
No external structure identifier or URL is emitted

scenarios.display_name: 运行级取消：N18 不启动
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖取消期间的 N16、未启动 N17/N18 和禁止汇合。
scenario_specific_assertions: Whole-run cancellation does not use tolerant branch join
E026 and E027 are absent

scenarios.display_name: N08 可恢复失败后成功
scenarios.purpose: 保留失败 attempt，并以独立 RECOVERY attempt 成功继续。
scenario_specific_assertions: Attempt 1 remains FAILED
Attempt 2 has recovery_of_attempt_number=1
No terminal record is overwritten

scenarios.display_name: 相同请求幂等重放
scenarios.purpose: 第二次相同 key 与规范化请求返回既有运行，不创建第二个运行。
scenario_specific_assertions: Second submission action is RETURN_EXISTING_RUN
Control literals are emitted once for the existing run

scenarios.display_name: 相同 key 但请求变化：拒绝
scenarios.purpose: 第二次提交改变规范化请求时显式返回幂等冲突。
scenario_specific_assertions: Second submission is rejected before a new run exists
Original run and control literals remain unchanged

scenarios.display_name: N18 组装失败：不得伪装完成
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖双支已汇合但 N18 自身失败的运行终止。
scenario_specific_assertions: E026 exists and E027 is absent
Existing upstream stubs are not promoted to a completed result

scenarios.display_name: N08 上游工具超时
scenarios.purpose: 覆盖 N01-N15 硬阻断下的 TIMED_OUT 运行终态和下游未执行。
scenario_specific_assertions: No success edge E009 exists
The timeout is injected by the scenario and never measured from wall-clock time
No control decision is inferred after the upstream terminal
